channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Chicago Fire host Inter Miami in Eastern Conference showdown
item.description: A Chicago win Wednesday cuts Inter Miami's lead to two points and extends the Fire's best home run of the season.

item.title: Mexico submits 2027 budget package as credit ratings hang in balance
item.description: Mexico's fiscal plan targets a 3.5% deficit by 2027, but rating agencies want proof the numbers hold up.

item.title: Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 opens with events across the US
item.description: From Kansas City's Fiesta Hispana to New York City's five boroughs, Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 kicks off September 15 with celebrations, culture, and community.

item.title: New Hampshire holds primary to fill Shaheen's open Senate seat
item.description: New Hampshire's first open Senate seat in nearly two decades is drawing crowded primaries that reveal fault lines within both parties.

item.title: Trump administration files third Supreme Court appeal on USPS mail ballot rules
item.description: The emergency application, the administration's third Supreme Court escalation on the matter, came days after a federal judge blocked the rules indefinitely.

item.title: Sheinbaum defends electoral system, criticizes PRI-PAN alliance at mañanera
item.description: Sheinbaum contrasted Mexico's citizen-run voting process with Colombia's private-sector involvement and called Fox a 'traitor to democracy.'

item.title: Experts weigh nearshoring opportunities and risks for Jalisco, Mexico
item.description: Universidad de Guadalajara experts say nearshoring can drive growth, but cargo crime and tariff uncertainty are slowing some investment decisions in Jalisco.

item.title: Murder trial opens in Mexico for three men in 2024 surfer killings
item.description: Three men charged with murdering two Australian brothers and an American surfer in Baja California faced their first court session Monday.

item.title: Salvadoran TPS expires September 9, ending 25-year designation
item.description: The 25-year Temporary Protected Status designation for El Salvador terminates September 9, 2026, affecting between 170,000 and 232,000 Salvadoran nationals.

item.title: US sanctions and blockade hit Iranian port city as gas prices surge
item.description: US sanctions and a naval blockade have idled Iran's busiest port as American gasoline prices hit record highs heading into Labor Day weekend.

item.title: Mexico women's team to play Jamaica in Aguascalientes for first time
item.description: El Estadio Victoria will host Mexico vs. Jamaica on October 9 — the senior women's side's first-ever match in Aguascalientes.

item.title: Julián Quiñones set to be named 2026 Ballon d'Or nominee
item.description: The Al-Qadsiah forward scored 33 goals in 31 league matches and four World Cup goals to earn a historic nod.

item.title: Messi sets MLS record as Inter Miami's Special Olympics team makes Nu Stadium debut
item.description: Messi's two assists pushed him to a milestone no MLS player has hit before, while a Unified team made history of its own under the same roof.

item.title: Republicans weigh payroll tax hike as Social Security fund nears depletion
item.description: A small but notable group of Republicans is signaling openness to lifting the Social Security payroll tax cap to avert automatic benefit cuts projected for 2032.

item.title: Giuliani calls on Mayor Mamdani to skip 9/11 memorial ceremony
item.description: Former Mayor Rudy Giuliani said Sunday that Mayor Zohran Mamdani should not attend the 9/11 memorial at Ground Zero marking the 25th anniversary.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner visit Moscow and Kyiv in Ukraine peace push
item.description: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held back-to-back meetings in Moscow and Kyiv as Washington pushed for trilateral peace talks.

item.title: Polls show most Argentines sour on Milei's economy at 1,000-day mark
item.description: Surveys published September 7 show nearly 59% of Argentines say their economic situation is getting worse as Milei hits 1,000 days in office.

item.title: Missouri redistricting battle reaches U.S. Supreme Court
item.description: A redistricting fight in Missouri has escalated to the nation's highest court, raising durable questions about who controls electoral maps and when.

item.title: Colombia inflation hits two-year high of 6.24% in August
item.description: Colombia's annual inflation climbed to 6.24% in August, topping forecasts and snapping a two-year downward trend, DANE reported Sunday.

item.title: Trump removes critical language from Arlington Confederate memorial marker
item.description: The administration quietly stripped critical language about slavery and the Confederacy from a marker and website at Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: UK government condemns anti-migrant protests at Portsmouth port
item.description: Police investigated assaults on officers and damage to vehicles after hundreds of masked protesters tried to block migrants from coming ashore in Portsmouth.

item.title: US immigration board rules Maduro's removal must factor in Venezuelan asylum cases
item.description: A precedent-binding BIA ruling requires immigration judges to weigh Nicolás Maduro's January 2026 ouster when assessing Venezuelan asylum claims.

item.title: ICE detains six at Illinois factory as daily arrest pace nears 2,000
item.description: ICE detained six workers at a McCook, Illinois factory on September 3, as the agency's daily arrest pace approaches an administration-set target of 2,000.

item.title: Chile posts $1.69B trade surplus in August as copper exports fall
item.description: Chile's August trade surplus rose 8.8% year-on-year to $1.69 billion, but copper — the country's top export — slid to its lowest since July 2025.

item.title: Voter coalitions tested across key 2026 midterm battlegrounds
item.description: From Jewish Democratic defections to Latino realignment reversals, 2026 is stress-testing assumptions about who votes for whom and why.

item.title: Messi records two assists in MLS return after Argentina retirement
item.description: Messi delivered two assists in a 2-2 draw with Atlanta United on Saturday, his first club match since retiring from Argentina duty.

item.title: Salvadoran TPS set to expire Sept. 9, affecting over 170,000
item.description: USCIS has set a September 9 termination date for El Salvador's TPS, though DHS has yet to publish a formal determination.

item.title: Trump threatens to bar Bombardier from US market
item.description: President Trump threatened Monday to bar Bombardier from the US market unless the Canadian planemaker shifts manufacturing to American soil.

item.title: Sheinbaum vows to sustain social programs, says Mexico props up US economy
item.description: Sheinbaum locks in welfare spending at a record 1.3 trillion pesos and touts $35 billion in foreign investment despite US tariff pressure.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on US goods take effect Sept. 8
item.description: Canada's counter-tariffs on roughly $19.9 billion USD in American goods began at 12:01 a.m. Tuesday, escalating a trade dispute that collapsed talks last month.

item.title: Costa Rica falls to Colombia in U-20 Women's World Cup opener
item.description: Sheika Scott gave Costa Rica an early lead, but Colombia leveled on a penalty to hand Las Ticas a 1-1 draw-turned-defeat in Poland.

item.title: Trump proposes renaming New Mexico 'New America' on social media
item.description: A viral hoax sparked a real presidential post, raising old questions about naming power, national identity, and how geography becomes politics.

item.title: Messi retires from Argentina after 21 years of international duty
item.description: At 39, Lionel Messi closes his Argentina chapter with 98 goals, 142 caps, and four major trophies across 21 years.

item.title: 2026 midterm campaigns enter final stretch on Labor Day
item.description: Labor Day 2026 opens the final sprint to November 3, with control of both chambers of Congress on the line.

item.title: Poitras ICE documentary 'They're Here' premieres at Venice
item.description: The 25-minute film, co-directed by Laura Poitras and Rachel Lauren Mueller, screened out of competition at the 83rd Venice Film Festival.

item.title: Messi and Atlanta's Junior Alonso clash after Miami's 2-2 draw
item.description: Messi confronted Junior Alonso after Atlanta's keeper denied a late equalizer, sparking a tunnel standoff that required players from both sides to intervene.

item.title: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt state election but falls short of majority
item.description: The AfD won 43.8 percent in Saxony-Anhalt but fell three seats short of a majority, leaving coalition prospects uncertain.

item.title: Armed man lunges at Ohio Democratic governor candidate at fair
item.description: Patrick Havas, 38, was arrested Sunday after forcing his way through a crowd toward Amy Acton at the Canfield Fair, authorities said.

item.title: Rutinel resigns Colorado House seat to focus on CD-8 race
item.description: State Rep. Manny Rutinel stepped down from the Colorado House on Sept. 4 to concentrate on his bid to unseat Republican Rep. Gabe Evans in CD-8.

item.title: UN rights chief demands accountability for 23 migrant deaths in US custody
item.description: UN Human Rights chief Volker Türk told the Human Rights Council that 23 migrants have died in US immigration custody in 2026.
